scope: Final four-file prepared-audio draft only. Independent source approval for handoff, not proof the failed preview is fixed. Prior request-changes receipts remain preserved.

resolved_source_findings.PREVIEW-PREP-01: Nonoptional arrangement is captured with plain let.
resolved_source_findings.PREVIEW-PREP-02: Preparation lease survives handoff. Final prepared predicate checks current lease/output revision, stage phase, same arrangement and exact arrangement/current-rate cache. Predicate and request.consume run without an intervening await before actual clock startup.
resolved_source_findings.PREVIEW-PREP-03: Cancel increments generation, captures and clears old handles, invokes rejection while ownership can still be checked, then cancels captured readiness/task. Old rejection cannot erase new handles; metronome command identity prevents an old request stopping a newer click.
resolved_source_findings.PREVIEW-PREP-04: Final predicate now retains phase==stage. Nonrecorded scene call uses explicit afterReady label.

lifetime_assessment: Preparation polls exact BandRenderKey at current renderer rate, not global pending state. Initial output activation establishes a revision-bound lease; cancellation, stale revision, changed phase or arrangement reject preparation.

Before handoff, local defer releases the lease on failure. startMelody returns whether gate accepted ownership, so already-pending rejection cannot leak the lease. On successful handoff, ready and rejection callbacks release it; gate clears rejection before ready and repeated cancel remains one-shot.

The current metronome request is established synchronously before gate handoff. Its metronomeRunning intent keeps output active when successful preparation ownership is released. Rejection stops only its still-current metronome request, protecting replacements.

Ordinary gate callers retain default prepared=true and rejected=nil. Recorded scenes alone wait for band preparation. Shared AudioStartGate and SongPerform changes still require native regression testing.

UI preview requires actual take-clock acknowledgment within60seconds and returns a failed missing-moment result when absent. Predicted clock fallback is removed; musical intervals and delivery gates remain unchanged.
authored_native_tests: Prepared lesson rechecks lease currency after held actual activation, starts zero clocks and releases once.
Repeated cancellation during pending activation invokes rejection once and later activation cannot start a clock.
Canceling already-ready but unconsumed startup stops its own metronome and releases output.
Replacing prepared startup rejects old request once, starts no old clock and preserves the newer click.
handoff_risks_and_remaining_work: All four new native tests are authored but unrun on Windows. Source approval is conditional on native AudioStartup, RecordingStartup and full app-target results.

No direct native regression proves different arrangement/rate cache entries cannot satisfy the exact cache probe. Source key matches renderer lookup; fresh real preview and controlled cache/rate coverage remain desirable.
The45second monotonic deadline covers band polling after output activation, not the entire hardware activation lifetime. Host scheduling and native behavior remain unverified.

A real native guitar preview must prove band readiness before take/hook, then satisfy original lock, poster, silence, duty-cycle, low-end and band-event gates. Existing c887 failed artifact remains failed.

Songs, ShowMe and results clip timing findings in preview-c887-timing-triage.json have not been fixed by this draft. Tuned/end-card audio failures and violin preview also remain open. No audio gate waiver or ready-for-upload claim.
